subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced by himself as the one who ties things to the ground for Daz to cook, and who killed an ettin with his hands, dragging the Pudding King through his own throne room.
source_quote: Zalthir ties things to the ground for Daz to cook

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir has run the tunnels in his head — the distance traveled, the pace, the absence of obvious threats immediately ahead.
source_quote: I had run the tunnels in my head — the distance we had traveled, the pace, the absence of obvious threats immediately ahead.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin mentioned javelins and had acquired some facility with thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct, trained in, applied to range — and wanted something with reach for the next engagement.
source_quote: Thorin mentioned javelins. He had apparently acquired some facility with thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct, trained in, applied to range — and he wanted something with reach for the next engagement.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin found the Ember Grapple very funny.
source_quote: Thorin said something about "the Ember Grapple." Someone — possibly Thorin again, possibly Grygum, it is hard to tell when they are both making noise — found this very funny.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir did not correct the name 'Ember Grapple.'
source_quote: I did not correct it. The name was not wrong.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir turned the matter over once, completely, and then put it down.
source_quote: I turned that over the way I turn most things over: once, completely, and then I put it down.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted the practicality of the Ember Grapple and moved on.
source_quote: I noted it and moved on.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir let the name 'Ember Grapple' settle.

subject: Ember Grapple
fact: The Ember Grapple is possibly the same party described from two different positions in the room as the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: Both accurate. Possibly the same party described from two different positions in the room.
